apps_bot_section_description: Give the app a bot: a managed Agent that each Workspace's owner or admin grants on the app's installation. The bot posts as the app and acts only when the app's backend calls.
apps_bot_enable_description: Declare that the app has a bot. Nothing is created until a Workspace owner or admin enables it on the installation.
apps_bot_enable_off_hint: Turning this off revokes every Workspace's grant and disables the app's bots at once.
apps_bot_save_first: Save the app before enabling its bot.
apps_bot_installation_description: This app has a bot. Enabling it adds a managed Agent to this Workspace that can be messaged, @-mentioned and added to channels. It posts as the app, takes no seat and runs nothing on its own; the app acts through it with its own key.
apps_bot_member_note: Ask a Workspace owner or admin to enable the bot.
apps_bot_error_handle_conflict: An Agent or a member already uses the handle @{handle}, so the bot can't be created. Rename it first.
apps_bot_error_not_declared: The app no longer declares a bot.
